name: claude-skills
description: A set of Claude Code skills for the whole development lifecycle: a delegate-to-Sonnet implementation flow with expensive-model review (/delegate), pre-push diff audits with auto-fix loops (/audit), full-codebase audits as a resumable goal-loop (/full-audit), a purely visual design audit (/design-audit), feature test matrices (/feature-audit), iterative planning with adversarial challenges and executor handoff (/plan-it), two-axis reviews (/review), issue triage with agent briefs (/triage), product-perspective analysis (/improve), production-baseline onboarding and compliance checks (/app-baseline, /baseline-check), skill scaffolding (/write-a-skill) and discovery (/find-skills), plus ship/diagnose/handoff workflows and personal skills for scheduled live-site audits and AI image/video generation. Markdown + Bash, no runtime dependencies.
